meaning:
A woman living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jos.2.1;
mother of: Boaz (H1162)(?)
§ Rahab, "spacious, broad"
Rachab, (Proper name), indeclinable, Mt. 1:5*

elsewhere.note: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.
